items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: Blind Freddy had the first band I played with.

ctx.x: The very first band I played on guitar? Well, banjo you say was first, huh?

Banjo, yeah. I used banjo and guitar. Yeah, I played, I had the ganjo and guitar both. Of course, the most you take, we didn't have no name, but you know, it was going to name. going to name, now you take oral, they became popular, just like silver leaf band, the golden leaf, and this boy, what is his name now, he had the on-wall band. Mani Perez. Mani Perez. Yeah. Well they had bands made up out of the jazz, they had brass bands and then they had string bands made up out of it. Now you take, the very first band…
Who was in Blind Freddy's band?
